en_US: I’m getting my Pidgey to fly a
letter to Saffron in the north.
I want to exchange Mail with all
sorts of people.
I send my Pidgey to a Union Room
to exchange Mail for me.
A figure made of paint turns to
face you. It raises a brush.
Dear Pippi,
I hope to see you soon.
I heard Saffron has problems with
Team Rocket.
Vermilion appears to be safe.
The figure’s colors swirl.
It’s waiting for you.
The figure is holding a stone that
shines in every color.
The figure runs like wet paint…
The world around it does too.
(Canvas DS: this part of the game
isn’t ported yet.)
